# Repository editing instructions

All reader-facing content must follow `TERMINOLOGY-RULE.md`.

When creating or editing Markdown, presentations, tables, SVGs or diagrams:

1. Expand every technical abbreviation at first meaningful use on that page/slide/visual: `Full Term (ABC)`.
2. If inline expansion would harm readability, add a visible terminology/acronym legend on the same page/slide/visual.
3. A glossary elsewhere in the repository is supplementary and does not replace same-page clarification.
4. Distinguish General Availability (GA) from Preview/Beta wherever release maturity affects a statement.
5. Use ETL and ELT only with the definitions in `TERMINOLOGY-RULE.md`.
6. Never introduce unexplained acronyms into headings, tables, charts, captions or standalone graphics.
7. Preserve product names that are not abbreviations; expand ambiguous short product names such as Jira Service Management (JSM).

Before finishing an edit, perform an acronym-readability pass over the complete changed page.
